verdict.rationale: Docs say Bugbot leaves inline PR comments with explanations and suggested fixes. It also offers 'Fix in Cursor' and 'Fix in Web' links that hand the issue off to the IDE or cloud agents. Nothing shows these suggestions are native committable diff blocks that can be applied with one click in the PR UI; the documented path goes through a separate Cursor session. Missing for 10: evidence of committable suggestion blocks (e.g., GitHub 'suggested changes') applied directly in the PR, a one-click apply/commit flow within the code host, and independent hands-on confirmation.
